paragraphs: Bath & Body Works is a global leader in personal care and home fragrance, driven by the belief that everybody deserves to feel good.

For over 35 years, the brand's beloved and iconic scents have been expertly crafted for exceptional performance and a luxury fragrance experience. Formulated with thoughtfully chosen ingredients, Bath & Body Works' body care products are available in multiple forms including fine fragrance mist, body cream, lotion, eau de parfum, body wash, hand soap, sanitizer and more, and home to our famous 3-wick candles. Consumers can shop Bath & Body Works anytime and anywhere they choose, from welcoming, in-store experiences at 1,927 company-operated stores in the United States of America ("U.S") and Canada, our e-commerce sites in the U.S. and Canada, 573 international stores and 34 e-commerce sites in more than 45 other countries, as well as Amazon.
Throughout this Annual Report on Form 10-K, we refer to Bath & Body Works, Inc. as "we" and the "Company."

We utilize the retail calendar for reporting and our fiscal year ends on the Saturday nearest to January 31. As a result, "2025" refers to the 52-week period ended January 31, 2026, "2024" refers to the 52-week period ended February 1, 2025 and "2023" refers to the 53-week period ended February 3, 2024.

Our strategy is rooted in the Consumer First Formula, launched in the third quarter of 2025, which puts the consumer at the center of everything we do. The Consumer First Formula is a multi-year, comprehensive transformation plan to revitalize Bath & Body Works across brand, product and marketplace. We are focused on our four largest revenue driving opportunities to try to attract new, younger consumers to the brand, which we expect will help us unlock our next era of sustainable growth:
•Creating Disruptive and Innovative Products: We intend to reestablish best in class product leadership in our hero categories.

•Reigniting the Brand: We expect to invest in marketing to build a brand with cultural currency, showing up in culture through creators, in store visuals and bigger storytelling, creating meaningful emotional connections with consumers.

•Winning in the Marketplace: We plan to expand access and ease of discovery through an enhanced digital experience, third-party channels and refreshed in-store merchandising to acquire new and lapsed consumers.

•Operating with Speed and Efficiency: We are working to transform Bath & Body Works to be a faster and more efficient organization by empowering teams, working with focus and agility to prioritize what customers care about most.
As we move forward under the Consumer First Formula, we believe the following competitive advantages endure and will help enable our return to sustainable growth:
•We are a market leader in attractive, growing categories; •We are an iconic brand with global recognition;
•We have a global store footprint with 2,500 locations employing a community of exceptional store associates;
•We have a customer loyalty program with 40 million active members; and
•We benefit from a fast, predominantly domestic, vertically-integrated supply chain.

paragraphs: Our 2025 performance did not meet our expectations. While we believe macroeconomic pressures impacted consumer sentiment throughout the year, we also underperformed in our sector. Accordingly, we took actions to help return the Company to sustainable growth. During the second quarter, we welcomed our new Chief Executive Officer, Daniel Heaf, to the business and, in the third quarter, launched the Consumer First Formula, our multi-year, comprehensive transformation plan to revitalize Bath & Body Works across brand, product and marketplace. The Consumer First Formula invests behind our four largest revenue driving opportunities to try to attract new, younger consumers to the brand, which we expect will help us unlock our next era of sustainable growth:
•Creating Disruptive and Innovative Products: We intend to reestablish best in class product leadership in our hero categories.

•Reigniting the Brand: We expect to invest in marketing to build a brand with cultural currency, showing up in culture through creators, in store visuals and bigger storytelling, creating meaningful emotional connections with consumers.

•Winning in the Marketplace: We plan to expand access and ease of discovery through an enhanced digital experience, third party channels and refreshed in-store merchandising to acquire new and lapsed consumers.

•Operating with Speed and Efficiency: We are working to transform Bath & Body Works to be a faster and more efficient organization by empowering teams, working with focus and agility to prioritize what customers care about most. We have plans to deliver $250 million in cost savings over the next two years, with $175 million expected in fiscal 2026. We expect that these savings will be used to invest in revenue-generating initiatives across product and brand.

For 2025, total Net Sales were $7,291 million, which decreased $16 million, or 0.2%, compared to 2024. Total North American Net Sales decreased $31 million compared to 2024, due to a decline in transactions mostly offset by increased order size, and International Net Sales increased $15 million. For 2025, Operating Income was $1,126 million, which decreased $140 million, or 11%, compared to 2024, and our Operating Income rate (expressed as a percentage of Net Sales) decreased to 15.4% from 17.3%. The Operating Income results were impacted by an increase in General, Administrative and Store Operating Expenses and a decline in our Gross Profit rate.
For additional information related to our 2025 financial performance, see "Results of Operations – 2025 Compared to 2024."

paragraphs: Bath & Body Works 是全球個人護理與居家香氛領域的領導品牌，基於相信每個人都應該感受到愉悅。

在超過 35 年的時間裡，該品牌的受歡迎且經典的香氣已經被精心打造，以提供卓越的表現與奢華的香氛體驗。Bath & Body Works 的身體護理產品是以經過深思熟慮選擇的成分製成，產品形式包括高級香氛霧、身體乳霜、乳液、香氛香水、身體潔膚乳、洗手乳、消毒液等，並包含我們著名的三支蠟燭。消費者可以依照自己的喜好，隨時隨地購物，從美國（"U.S"）與加拿大總部經營的 1,927 家實體門市、美國與加拿大電商網站、超過 45 個國家的 573 家國際門市與 34 個電商網站，以及 Amazon 進行購物。
在本年度 10-K 申報文件中，我們將 Bath & Body Works, Inc. 簡稱為 "we" 並稱為 "the Company."
我們使用零售曆進行財務報告，財務年度結算日為距離 1 月 31 日最近的星期六。因此，"2025" 代表的是截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日的 52 週期間，"2024" 代表的是截至 2025 年 2 月 1 日的 52 週期間，"2023" 代表的是截至 2024 年 2 月 3 日的 53 週期間。
我們的策略根植於 Consumer First Formula，於 2025 年第三季啟動，將消費者置於我們所有行動的中心。Consumer First Formula 是一個跨年度、全面性的轉型計畫，旨在重振 Bath & Body Works 品牌、產品與市場。我們專注於四大主要營收驅動機會，以吸引新進、年輕的消費者，我們預期這將幫助我們啟動下一個可持續成長的時代：
•創造顛覆性與創新性產品：我們預計重新建立在核心類別中的最佳產品領導地位。
•重燃品牌聲量：我們預期投資於行銷，建立一個具有文化價值的品牌，透過創作者、實體門市視覺與更強大的敘事故事，出現在文化中，與消費者建立有意義的情感連結。
•在市場中取得勝利：我們計畫透過增強的數位體驗、第三方通路與更新的實體門市陳列，擴大接觸與發現的便利性，以吸引新進與迴流消費者。
•運作快速且高效：我們致力於將 Bath & Body Works 轉型為一個更快速且更高效的組織，透過賦予團隊自主權，專注且靈活地運作，以優先處理顧客最關心的事項。
在推動 Consumer First Formula 的過程中，我們相信以下競爭優勢持續存在，並將有助於我們實現可持續的成長：
•我們是具吸引力且成長迅速的類別市場領導者；•我們是一個具有全球認知度的標誌性品牌；
•我們擁有全球門店網路，包含 2,500 個門店，並僱用了一羣優秀的門店員工；
•我們擁有顧客忠誠度計畫，擁有 4000 萬名活躍會員；以及
•我們受益於快速、以美國為主的垂直整合供應鏈

paragraphs: 我們 2025 年的表現未達預期。雖然我們認為總體經濟壓力影響了全年消費者的意願，但我們在產業中也表現不佳。因此，我們採取行動以協助本公司重回可持續的成長軌道。在第二季，我們迎來了新任首席執行長 Daniel Heaf 加入業務，並在第三季啟動了 Consumer First Formula，這是我們跨年度、全面性的轉型計畫，用以重振 Bath & Body Works 的品牌、產品與市場。Consumer First Formula 投資於我們四大營收驅動機會，以吸引新的年輕消費者至品牌，我們預期這將幫助我們啟動下一階段的可持續成長：
•建立創新且具有顛覆性的產品：我們意圖在英雄類別中重新建立最佳產品領導地位。
•重燃品牌活力：我們預期會投資於行銷，建立一個具有文化價值的品牌，透過創作者、店內視覺與更大的敘事故事，出現在文化中，與消費者建立有意義的情感連結。
•在市場中取得勝利：我們計畫透過增強的數位體驗、第三方通路與更新的店內商品陳列，擴大接觸與發現的便利性，以吸引新消費者與迴流消費者。
•以速度與效率運作：我們正在努力將 Bath & Body Works 轉型為一個更快、更高效的組織，透過賦能團隊、專注與靈活應變，優先處理消費者最關心的事項。我們有計畫在未來兩年內實現 2.5 億美元的成本節省，其中 1.75 億美元預期在財務 2026 年實現。我們預期這些節省將用於投資於產品與品牌的營收生成計畫。

2025 年總淨銷售額為 72.91 億美元，較 2024 年減少 1,600 萬美元，或 0.2%。總北美地區淨銷售額較 2024 年減少 3,100 萬美元，主因為交易量減少，但訂單規模增加所抵銷；國際淨銷售額則增加 1,500 萬美元。2025 年營運獲利為 11.26 億美元，較 2024 年減少 1.4 億美元，或 11%，且營運獲利率（以淨銷售額百分比表示）從 17.3% 下降至 15.4%。營運獲利結果受到一般及行政費用與店鋪運營費用增加，以及毛利率下降的影響。
如需更多關於我們 2025 年財務表現的資訊，請參閱 "營運成果 – 2025 年與 2024 年比較"。
